name: MKT_IMP_TRMT_URLS_ASSOC
description: This interface table stores staging data for the treatment-url associations.  The data gets populated into MKT_TM_TRMT_URLS_ASSOC table.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Primary Key - Identifier that groups data into a batch

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Primary Key - Used to link with rows in the error table

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the status of the record to be processed

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the operation to be performed on a row, such as Insert, Update, etc.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: File Record Number. Record indicator in the File.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: TRMT_EXT_REF
columns.description: Treatment External Reference.  Stores the unique identifier of the treatment in the source system.

columns.name: TREATMENT_ID
columns.description: Treatment id.  Fusion id of the treatment.

columns.name: URL_EXT_REF
columns.description: URL External Reference.  Stores the unique identifier of the url in the source system.

columns.name: URL_ID
columns.description: This is the URL id.  Fusion id of the URL.

columns.name: CLICK_COUNT
columns.description: This is the click count attribute.

columns.name: TRMT_URL_ID
columns.description: Fusion id of the url-promotion association

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
